scenario.topic: Select the product features for the next prototype release

options.name: Enhanced User Interface with Dark Mode
options.upside: Improves user experience and accessibility during low-light conditions
options.concern: Requires additional design and testing resources

options.name: Real-Time Data Sync Feature
options.upside: Enables up-to-date information across devices instantly
options.concern: May increase server load and require infrastructure adjustments

options.name: Offline Mode with Local Data Storage
options.upside: Allows use without internet connection, improving reliability
options.concern: Complex data synchronization needed when reconnecting

options.name: Third-Party Service Integration API
options.upside: Expands functionality by connecting with external services
options.concern: Potential security risks and dependency on external providers

shared_context: The team is selecting product features for the next prototype release, focusing on usability, performance, and integration capabilities. Each option includes a set of features with estimated development time and resource requirements.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a mobile developer focused on improving app reliability and offline capabilities.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the product works seamlessly without internet to enhance user satisfaction.

A.reason_for: Improves user experience and accessibility, which benefits all users.
A.reason_against: Requires additional design and testing resources that could slow development.

B.reason_for: Real-time sync is useful but less critical than offline functionality for reliability.
B.reason_against: May increase server load and infrastructure complexity.

C.reason_for: Allows use without internet, directly supporting my goal of improving reliability.

D.reason_for: Expands functionality through integrations, which is valuable but less urgent.
D.reason_against: Potential security risks and dependency on external providers.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a backend developer passionate about real-time data and system performance.
personas.private_goal: Deliver fast, up-to-date data synchronization to improve user engagement.

A.reason_for: Enhances user interface, but less impactful on backend performance.
A.reason_against: Requires UI/UX resources and offers minimal performance impact.

B.reason_for: Enables instant data updates, aligning with my focus on performance and engagement.

C.reason_for: Offline mode is useful but less critical than real-time sync for user engagement.
C.reason_against: Data sync complexity could introduce bugs.

D.reason_for: Integration APIs can extend backend capabilities and add value.
D.reason_against: Security risks and dependency on external services need careful management.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a QA engineer focused on ensuring smooth integration and system stability.
personas.private_goal: Prioritize features that balance integration and performance without overloading resources.

A.reason_for: Improves user experience but has minimal integration impact.
A.reason_against: Additional design and testing resources needed.

B.reason_for: Real-time sync improves system integration and user experience.

C.reason_for: Offline mode adds complexity to data synchronization, increasing testing burden.
C.reason_against: Partial integration and moderate performance impact complicate stability.

D.reason_for: High integration level expands functionality and aligns with system goals.
D.reason_against: Security risks and external dependencies require thorough QA.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is an API developer specializing in secure third-party integrations.
personas.private_goal: Expand product capabilities through secure and efficient external service connections.

A.reason_for: Enhances user experience with minimal performance impact.
A.reason_against: Requires UI/UX resources which are not my focus.

B.reason_for: Real-time sync is beneficial but may strain infrastructure.
B.reason_against: Moderate performance impact and backend changes needed.

C.reason_for: Offline mode adds complexity and synchronization challenges.
C.reason_against: Partial integration and moderate performance impact are concerns.

D.reason_for: Expands functionality via external services, matching my expertise and goals.

acceptance_reasons.D: Integration APIs can extend backend capabilities and add value.
